title: Shailene Woodley Recalls Her “Dream” Role as Mary Jane Being Cut From ‘The Amazing Spider-Man 2’
summary: "Spider-Man's my favorite superhero; Mary Jane was my favorite character growing up. So, when I got it, I was like, 'This is so exciting!'" the actress said before adding that she and Andrew Garfield filmed three scenes together that didn't make it into the 2014 movie.
